answer: We define a mechanism where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds anchor identity claims against a subgame-perfect punishment matrix, ensuring that the marginal cost of provisioning liquidity exceeds the nectar of illicit consensus rewards. By imposing slashing penalties on multi-identity vectors, we extend a financial jetty into the state space, rendering the expected utility of Sybil multiplication strictly negative. Rational agents converge to a unique Nash equilibrium where honest staking remains the optimal strategy to maximize capital efficiency.
